reports.title: Appian Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: As of November 5, 2026, guidance for 2026 is as follows:
◦Cloud subscriptions revenue is expected to be between $143.0 million and $145.0 million, representing year-over-year growth of 22% to 24%.
◦Total revenue is expected to be between $233.0 million and $237.0 million, representing a year-over-year increase of 15% to 17%.
◦Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be between $30.0 million and $33.0 million.
◦Non-GAAP earnings per share is expected to be between $0.30 and $0.34, assuming weighted average common shares outstanding of 73.4 million.
◦Cloud subscriptions revenue is expected to be between $536.0 million and $538.0 million, representing year-over-year growth of 23%.
◦Total revenue is expected to be between $873.0 million and $877.0 million, representing a year-over-year increase of 20% to 21%.
◦Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be between $116.0 million and $119.0 million.
◦Non-GAAP earnings per share is expected to be between $1.20 and $1.24, assuming weighted average common shares outstanding of 73.5 million.
